Small areas of Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly

Source: R/data_cornwall.R
cornwall_lsoa.Rd

The 337 Lower layer Super Output Areas (LSOA 2021) of NHS Cornwall and Isles of Scilly ICB, with population, registered patients and population-weighted centroids.

Usage

cornwall_lsoa

Format

An sf polygon object (EPSG:27700) with 337 rows and columns:

lsoa, name

LSOA 2021 code and name; lsoa matches cornwall_flows and the rows of cornwall_travel.

ruc21

2021 rural-urban classification.

pop, pop_0_15, pop_16_64, pop_65p

ONS mid-2024 population estimates, all ages and by age band.

registered

Residents registered at any GP practice in England.

registered_in

Residents registered at a Cornwall and Isles of Scilly practice (row totals of cornwall_flows).

registered_out

Residents registered at a practice elsewhere.

cent_x, cent_y

Population-weighted centroid (EPSG:27700), the origin used for cornwall_travel.

scilly

TRUE for the Isles of Scilly area.

geometry

Super-generalised (200 m) clipped boundary.

Source

Office for National Statistics: LSOA 2021 boundaries with rural-urban classification, population-weighted centroids and mid-2024 small-area population estimates (via Nomis); NHS England registrations (July 2026). Open Government Licence v3.0; contains OS data. See system.file("COPYRIGHTS", package = "spax").

Details

Registered counts exceed the population estimates by about 4%, reflecting list inflation and the different reference dates.

See also

cornwall_gp, cornwall_flows, cornwall_travel

Examples

areas <- sf::st_drop_geometry(cornwall_lsoa)
summary(areas$registered_in / areas$registered)
#>    Min. 1st Qu.  Median    Mean 3rd Qu.    Max. 
#>  0.6624  0.9965  0.9986  0.9919  0.9994  1.0000 
table(areas$ruc21)
#> 
#>  Larger rural: Further from a major town or city 
#>                                               73 
#>     Larger rural: Nearer to a major town or city 
#>                                                8 
#> Smaller rural: Further from a major town or city 
#>                                               92 
#>    Smaller rural: Nearer to a major town or city 
#>                                               11 
#>         Urban: Further from a major town or city 
#>                                              135 
#>            Urban: Nearer to a major town or city 
#>                                               18
